summary: Inspected retained page renders and metrics at 375, 390, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1440 px. Fonts are ready at every width and the page has no reported horizontal overflow from 390 through 1440 px. The 768-1440 layouts remain readable, but both narrow-phone grain cards are unusably constrained and the 375 px supply card clips horizontally. Shared header/footer/CTA visuals were not re-audited.
issues: RESP-ABOUT-001 | priority: critical | property: narrow-phone grain-card layout | expected: derived mobile layout keeps heading, rich text and photo readable within the 335/350 px card, normally by stacking the two columns | actual: at 375 px the text column is only 143.546875 px and the photo is 101.453125x75.140625; at 390 px the text column is 152.328125 px and photo 107.65625x79.734375, causing near one-word-per-line copy and 1715.125/1620.125 px card heights | fix: stack the grain text and image at the phone breakpoint and give both the available card width.

RESP-ABOUT-002 | priority: high | property: horizontal overflow/clipping at 375 px | expected: all route-owned content fits the 375 px viewport with zero horizontal overflow | actual: responsive-375 reports overflow=1, and supply children at x=50 with width=329.203125 end at x=379.203125; the heading, paragraph, photo and third item label are visibly clipped at the right edge | fix: remove the fixed/over-wide mobile supply child width and size it to the card content box so right edge is at or before 355 px.
